Cully now activates only through `cully run`. Hooks, the skill and the workflow skill are gated on the run marker, so direct `claude`, `codex` and `cursor-agent` launches stay fully native, and setup no longer writes Codex `AGENTS.md` guidance. The Cully status line is removed in favour of the panel, and `cully setup --all --prepare` is gone.

Add an opt-in left sidebar of named sessions with `cully run --sidebar AGENT` (or `CULLY_SIDEBAR=1`): start, switch and rename sessions, each with its own agent, input and scroll position. Renames must be unique.

Terminal support is now capability-based: Ghostty, iTerm2, Kitty, WezTerm, Alacritty, macOS Terminal and native Linux terminals work; Warp stays unsupported. Setup applies a backed-up Nerd Font and zsh preset automatically, and terminal check/configure/restore commands verify rendering honestly. macOS and Linux only.
